agent_prompt: Glitch Spot annotation snapshot. Each entry in 'annotations' is a labelled rectangle (by 'label': '01', '02', …) drawn over the captured screenshot. The 'note' field is the user's feedback for that region. 'images.annotated' is the screenshot with rectangles and badges rendered; 'images.clean' is the original. When addressing feedback, reference annotations by their label. Any entries in 'redactions' mark regions the user intentionally hid; their pixels are destroyed in both images — do not attempt to infer their contents.
